title: Normal and Poisson approximation for Gibbs point processes with pair potentials
summary: We provide a Poisson approximation result for dependent thinnings of Gibbs point processes as well as qualitative and quantitative central limit theorems for geometric functionals of Gibbs point processes in increasing observation windows. The present paper extends prior work on finite-range Gibbs processes to processes with repulsive pairwise interaction of unbounded interaction range as well as processes on marked Euclidean space.
